evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies the low-level socket polling and peer disconnection behavior in the network event loop.
rationale: Prevents the network event loop from spinning continuously when incoming TCP urgent data triggers select's exception set. According to the description, 'incoming TCP urgent data triggers select()'s exception set, which can cause the network event loop to spin continuously when no regular data is available to read', making this an important fix for remote CPU exhaustion.
